short_name.description: Short name or abbreviation, per language. Example: { "en": "AUEB", "el": "ΟΠΑ" }

languages.description: Languages the site is written in: en (English), el (Greek). Example: ["el", "en"]

default_language.description: The language shown first: en or el. Must be one of the languages above if you list them. Example: el

departments.description: The folder names of the departments, in the order they appear on the site. A department that is not listed here is not shown.
